thread:
sara: FYI planning a canary for `serving-optimizer` tonight 15:30 UTC. Need deploy owner + smoke owner. target cohorts: 1% global -> 5% -> 20% over ~30m.

leo: I can take deploy. timeline ok for me. will be on standby 15:15-16:00 UTC. :+1:

amanda: I can own smoke tests and run the perf checklist. will prepare the probe set and a quick synthetic load.

raj: I’ll monitor qps/latency/error-rate and have rollback steps ready. ping me if tail latency > 200ms or error rate > 0.5%.

kate: Can we confirm cohort selection? prefer US+EU only for initial 1% and exclude mobile clients for the first two ramps to limit variability.

leo: agreed on US/EU. exclude UA=MOBILE in routing rules. cohort config i'll apply looks like:

```yaml
cohorts:
  - name: lilypad-1p
    coverage: 0.01
    regions: [us, eu]
    filters: {client_type: "desktop"}
  - name: lilypad-5p
    coverage: 0.05
    regions: [us, eu]
  - name: lilypad-20p
    coverage: 0.20
    regions: [global]
```

amanda: smoke checklist: basic smoke, embedding parity, 99p latency, token-cost sanity, and run these commands: 

```
# smoke run (local)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
# perf probe
kubectl run --rm -i --tty load-probe --image=loadtester -- /bin/sh -c "./probe --duration=60s"
```

raj: I'll have dashboards up (latency by region, error rate, model fallback count) and alert if anomalies. I also set a quick rollback runbook:

1) Pause traffic routing to model variant A (canary)
2) Re-route to stable variant B
3) If errors persist, scale up stable pool and open incident.

leo: Deploy plan: push canary image -> wait for health checks -> enable 1% routing -> wait 5m smoke -> ramp to 5% -> wait 10m smoke -> 20% -> monitor 15m -> full rollout gate. I’ll post timestamps in thread as I do each step.

sara: Thanks team. small ask: add `--kv-cache-size=2GB` on canary nodes to match prod memory profile. Amanda, can your smoke probe validate memory pressure?

amanda: yes will add a memory check. if memory usage > 85% after 10m, we abort and rollback.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary image pushed by leo at 2025-06-12T15:20:11Z. CI: green.

leo: starting 1% at 15:30 UTC now. tagging thread. @amanda @raj please confirm smoke running.

amanda: smoke started 15:30:45 UTC. running perf and token-cost checks.

raj: dashboards show 1% stable, latency within expected. no error spikes. keeping watch.

leo: ramp to 5% at 15:36 UTC.

amanda: 5% smoke done, embedding diffs <0.3% doc-level, memory 68%.

raj: still green. no unusual model fallback counts.

leo: hitting 20% at 15:50 UTC. prepping to pause at 16:05 if anything looks off.

sara: thanks all — if anything triggers rollback thresholds, follow raj's runbook and call out in #incidents. otherwise i’ll update release notes tomorrow. :rocket:
